difficulty_reason: Condition once on the middle variable: take the monotone witness couplings of P1 with P2 and of P2 with P3, read off the two conditional kernels given omega2, and recombine them as a product kernel given omega2. Each kernel is supported where the corresponding witness lives, so the product is supported on {omega1 >= omega2 >= omega3}; the marginals are P1, P2, P3 by construction. Existing H2 ruling reused with its medium-confidence qualifier: external existence theorem cited, marginal/support verification implicit. No generalisation or proof expansion.
